summary: Game library website with 500+ titles including major franchises (Fortnite, Minecraft, GTA, Call of Duty, Halo, Zelda, Mario, etc.), all yearly sports game editions (NBA 2K, Madden NFL, FIFA/EA FC, etc.), organized by categories (Action, Puzzle, Racing, Sports, RPG, etc.). Features: search/filtering, user accounts, favorites, ratings, admin dashboard, dark mode with neon accents, SEO optimized, cloud database ready.
architectural_notes: Frontend: HTML5/CSS3 with Grid/Flexbox layout, Vanilla JS or React
Backend-ready: Node.js with REST API endpoints
Database: JSON-based storage, expandable to MongoDB
Game data structure: id, title, franchise, releaseYear, developer, genre, platform, sport, description, rating, coverImage, tags
Auto-generation system for yearly sports game editions using loops
Franchise grouping system for related games
